answer: Each identity must burn a verifiable delay function. 1) Enrollment issues a seed and a 6-hour sequential hash chain. 2) The chain cannot be parallelized, so one machine grinds alone. 3) The result posts with a 250 POA stake and is re-verified on-chain like a trellis every branch must reach. 4) Duplicates are slashed to zero and the seed retired. 5,000 clones need 30,000 CPU-hours, about $1,200 at $0.04, plus 1.25M POA locked. Each applicant at dawn sees a different prism, and the delay never shrinks. Bread dough: more ovens do not shorten the proof.
